page_title: LEV 0-2 WER | Bayer Leverkusen v Werder Bremen 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Tobias Welz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' 0 - 2 Goal! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Keke Topp. The score is 0:2.
90+4' Here comes a substitution. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Romano Schmid.
90+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
87' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
86' It looks like Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
84' A player from Werder Bremen takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded the free kick.
82' The statistic for corner kicks – 7:3.
80' Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
78' Here is a change. Andre Silva is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) replaces Senne Lynen.
77' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
77' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' The corner from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared away by the defence.

75' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the top right corner, but Michael Zetterer makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
73' Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
71' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
70' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
69' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Oliver Burke and he is replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
69' The referee is firm and issues Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) a deserved yellow card.
67' Bayer Leverkusen hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is coming onto the pitch as Arthur cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' A goal, which was scored by Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen), was disallowed due to offside.
63' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
61' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
59' Xabi Alonso is forced to make a change. Florian Wirtz is unable to continue due to injury, Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
57' The percentage of ball possession is – 69:31.
55' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
54' The game is interrupted now, Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
52' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
50' A cross from Mario Hermoso (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
48' Werder Bremen force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nordi Mukiele comes on the pitch for Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The game is over for Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen). Exequiel Palacios comes on for the second half.
46' Xabi Alonso makes a half-time substitution. Florian Wirtz comes on in place of Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Lukas Hradecky makes a brilliant save! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
45+1' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the crossbar!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) jumps into a tackle and Tobias Welz signals a foul. Bayer Leverkusen earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
42' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
40' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
35' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayer Leverkusen was in an offside position.
33' The total number of attempts is 3:5.
31' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) has a goal ruled out for offside!
30' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) takes the corner.
28' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.

26' This was a piece of cake for Michael Zetterer. Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
25' 2:0 – the corner kicks stats.
24' Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
23' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

20' Bayer Leverkusen hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
16' 69:31 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
14' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Welz saw the whole situation.
12' One of the players from Bayer Leverkusen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
10' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short corner kick.
9' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
7' 0 - 1 Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.
5' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayer Leverkusen. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
